LightningComponentBundle.description: Public hero banner for an Experience Cloud site that welcomes guest visitors and invites them to chat with the Personal Portfolio Agent.

property.name: ownerName
property.label: Owner Name
property.description: Portfolio owner's display name shown in the welcome headline.

property.name: roleTitle
property.label: Role / tagline (eyebrow)
property.description: Short role shown above the headline, e.g. 'Salesforce Architect and Agentforce Builder'.

property.name: location
property.label: Location (optional)
property.description: Shown next to your social links in the hero, e.g. 'Bengaluru, India'.

property.name: subheadline
property.label: Subheadline
property.default: Ask the assistant in the corner anything about my background, experience, and projects.

property.name: avatarUrl
property.label: Avatar image URL (optional)
property.description: Profile photo shown in the hero. Leave blank to show the owner's initials. External image hosts must be added as CSP Trusted Sites.

property.name: showItems
property.label: Show portfolio items grid
property.description: List active Portfolio Items as rich cards below the hero (YouTube previews, link previews, category filters).
